nodes.label: Row Level Security
nodes.rationale: Permissions are checked both on the server and in the database so access does not depend on the UI.

nodes.norm_label: emblemas de build (fundo do cartao do membro)
nodes.rationale: Theme colour comes from graduation, so the image must be only the shape: black on pure white, later turned into transparency.

nodes.norm_label: medalhoes de arquearia (bronze master + svg filters for prata/ouro)
nodes.rationale: Independent silver and gold generations were discarded after review; all three levels reuse the bronze image with calibrated SVG colour filters.

nodes.norm_label: icones de patentes, graduacoes e builds (insignias)

nodes.norm_label: ordem (cavalaria/arquearia) determines graduation medal; neutral medal if ambiguous
nodes.rationale: When order is absent or ambiguous a neutral medal is used rather than assigning an order to the member.

nodes.label: Google Cloud OAuth Web client (Client ID/Secret)
nodes.norm_label: google cloud oauth web client (client id/secret)
nodes.rationale: Only openid, email and profile scopes; ID and secret live in Supabase, never in Git.

nodes.label: Disable public sign-ups (14.5)
nodes.rationale: Prevents GoTrue creating users for unknown Google accounts; does not affect invite signup done via admin API.

nodes.label: Delete Google-created account when no profile exists (/auth/callback)
nodes.norm_label: delete google-created account when no profile exists (/auth/callback)

nodes.label: Self-hosted Supabase GoTrue Google env vars (14.3)
nodes.norm_label: self-hosted supabase gotrue google env vars (14.3)
nodes.rationale: API_EXTERNAL_URL without /auth/v1 makes GoTrue build a wrong callback causing redirect_uri_mismatch, hence explicit GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI; service must be recreated, not restarted.

nodes.label: Login com Google (section 14)
nodes.rationale: Additional access path only for approved members; profiles.status and is_approved_member() remain the security source; no RLS change or new migration.

nodes.label: Google login does not grant access automatically (approved members only)
nodes.norm_label: google login does not grant access automatically (approved members only)
nodes.rationale: Pending or unregistered members remain blocked even with a valid Google account.
